visual.general_description: Line chart of serum valproic acid and ammonia values from Day 0 to Day 11 with treatment annotations.
visual.detailed_description: Two-series line chart on a white background with horizontal grid lines. The y-axis is labeled Values with ticks from 0 to 500 in steps of 50; the x-axis carries Day 0 to Day 11. The blue valproic acid line starts at 450 on Day 0 and falls steeply through 339 and 93 to 24.5, 5.9 and 2.8 by Day 5. The orange ammonia line stays between 76 and 59 over Day 0 to Day 3, has a label 67 at Day 5 and continues at 45, 46, 53 and 41 on Days 7, 8, 10 and 11. Small text under the day labels reads Intubated, MAC, Naloxone, L-carnitine, CRRT, Gastroscopy, ICU at Day 0; L-carnitine stopped at Day 1; MAC stopped at Day 2; CRRT stopped at Day 3; Extubated at Day 5; EPS at Day 7; Shifted to ward at Day 11. A legend at the bottom names Valproic Acid and Ammonia.
